title: 第十二章 装备店的剑

content_zh:
“神棍！”蒂法的声音突然响起，林铮才想起来，队伍频道一直没关啊！擦！难不成刚刚的话都被他们听到了？
“什么事？”林铮有点警惕地问道！
“神棍！赶紧把你那个人气比孙雨还高的妹子叫过来！”龙牙在队伍里狼嚎道，擦！就是有你在我才警惕啊！林铮心中叫道！
“去死！你要是敢对她出手，我就剥了你的皮！”蒂法语气森然地说道，随后，龙牙的惨叫声便不绝于耳地传到林铮耳中，听得林铮一阵恶寒！无法想象那一头到底进行着什么酷刑。等到龙牙咽了气，蒂法的心情似乎好多了，很开心地对林铮道：“我可是萌妹后援团的第一任会长啊！赶紧把我的小心肝带过来！我想死她了！”
缘分这东西，真是太不可思议了！好家伙，萌妹后援团还真的存在，而且认识的人里面居然还有人是前会长的说！这难道是一个很庞大的神秘组织？！
林铮在森林里找到了有希和小萌，看小萌四处警惕，防贼似的，林铮都感到好笑。上前与二人汇合，稍作解释之后，小萌与有希跟着林铮前往蒂法他们的练级点。胜利会师之后，小萌很是兴奋地冲向了蒂法！“蒂法姐姐！”得，居然也是认识的！
“乖了！”蒂法温柔地摸着小萌的头道，“进来玩了也不联系我，真该打！”
“这不是不知道你的id嘛，嘿嘿！还有，我终于把有希拉进来了！你看！”说着，小萌献宝似的将身后的有希推向前来！几个大男人看着被推出来的有希，一下全愣住了，这！这！怎么会有让人感觉如此单纯的女孩，清新得好像看到了美丽的雪莲，那一双眼睛，仿佛是世间最美丽纯净的宝石，美得惊心动魄！
“咝~~”三个大男人抽了一口凉气，这真是美得祸国殃民了，难怪人气居然能超过国际巨星孙雨！几乎同时，三人将目光落到了林铮脸上，这货是木头吗？这么漂亮的妹子居然不动心，还一副大哥哥疼爱妹妹的表情！对了，他是有希的青梅竹马啊！顿时，各种羡慕嫉妒恨的心情全涌上了三人心头，林铮突然身子一寒，抬头一看，三个人正双眼喷火地死死盯着他。“什么时候得罪这仨货了！？”林铮郁闷不已。
“有希！”蒂法高兴地搂住了有希，“想死姐姐我了！让姐姐看看！唔——还是这么可爱！有希最可爱了！”
“你确定，你不是把有希当成很可爱的玩具吗？”
“当然不是！”蒂法严词否定，“哪有有希这么可爱的玩具！”得，果然是当玩具了！
叹了口气，林铮望了一下有希那没有情绪的精致小脸，问道：“有希，你开心吗？”
有希清澈的双眼望着林铮数秒，好像这个问题很难回答似的，所有人也都安静下来注视着有希，一直沉默寡言的有希，她的心情是怎么样的？有希可能并不了解众人所期待的是什么，但是对于问题，她总会很认真地回答一下，在几个人的关注下，有希轻轻地点了下头，眨动着眼睛说道：“嗯！开心！”
“是嘛！”听到有希的回答，林铮放心地笑了，“那就好，你开心就行！”
“耶——！”小萌和蒂法一阵欢呼，旁边三个大男人也松了口气，大概觉得让这么一个清新脱俗的女孩不开心时一种很大的罪过吧！
欢喜的相见后，接下来该好好地练级了！不过这会儿又出现了一个问题！队长50级以下，只能组建一个六人的队伍，现在人数是7人，而且等下小喵还要上来，那就是八人！如此一来，不得不分队了。小萌和有希是肯定在一块的，蒂法的话也是，然后按照蒂法的喜好，小喵绝对也会被她拉走。四男四女，似乎就是这样了，不过最后小萌以女生实力不比男生为由，拉走了林铮，在三双喷火的眼睛怒视下，林铮加入了女生队。没办法，这里就林铮最让几个女生放心了。
两点十分，小喵上线了，没有意外的被蒂法拉进了队伍，没有医生的霸王他们那是内牛满面！不过还好，毕竟都是在一块练级，霸王缺血了小喵也会跑上去奶一下，让霸王不至于被怪群殴致死！
女生队这一边虽然没有甲士，不过倒也没有什么危险，关键是输出很强大！蒂法换了武器之后，输出直追林铮，加上林铮和小萌，很轻松就能将一小拨怪灭个干净，掉的血量没有太多，何况还有小喵在加血。有希的话很是独特，居然一手拿着书看着一手拿着魔杖不停地扔魔法，让人无语的是她的魔法居然没有失手过！

content_en:
"Magical stick!" Tifa's voice suddenly sounded, and Lin Zheng remembered that the team channel had been turned off! wipe! Could it be possible that they heard what they just said?
"What's the matter?" Lin Zheng asked a little warily!
"Magical stick! Hurry up and call your girl who is more popular than Sun Yu!" Longya howled in the team, "Shit!" It’s only because you’re here that I’m vigilant! Lin Zheng shouted in his heart!
"Go to hell! If you dare to attack her, I will skin you!" Tifa said in a solemn tone, and then, the screams of Long Ya continued to reach Lin Zheng's ears, which made Lin Zheng feel chills! I can't imagine what kind of torture was going on on the other end. When Long Ya died, Tifa seemed to be in a much better mood, and said to Lin Zheng happily: "I am the first president of the cute girl support group! Bring my little sweetheart here quickly! I miss her so much!"
Fate is such an incredible thing! Good guy, the cute girl support group really does exist, and there is actually someone I know who is the former president! Is this a huge mysterious organization? !
Lin Zheng found Youxi and Xiaomeng in the forest. Lin Zheng was amused when he saw Xiaomeng being vigilant and guarding against thieves. They stepped forward to join the two. After a brief explanation, Xiaomeng and Youxi followed Lin Zheng to Tifa's leveling point. After the victory, Xiaomeng rushed towards Tifa very excitedly! "Sister Tifa!" Yes, we actually know each other!
"Be good!" Tifa gently touched Xiao Meng's head and said, "You came in to play and didn't contact me. You really deserve a beating!"
"I don't know your ID, hehe! Also, I finally brought Yuxi in! Look!" As he said that, Xiaomeng pushed Yuxi forward like a treasure! Several grown men were stunned when they saw Yuxi being pushed out. This! this! How could there be a girl who makes people feel so innocent? She is as fresh as if she has seen a beautiful snow lotus. Her eyes are like the most beautiful and pure gems in the world, so beautiful that it is breathtaking!
"Hiss~~" The three grown men gasped. This is so beautiful that it brings disaster to the country and the people. No wonder it is more popular than the international superstar Sun Yu! Almost at the same time, the three of them cast their eyes on Lin Zheng's face. Is this wood? Such a beautiful girl is not moved, and she looks like a big brother who loves his little sister! By the way, he is Yuki’s childhood sweetheart! Suddenly, all kinds of feelings of envy, jealousy and hatred surged into the hearts of the three of them. Lin Zheng suddenly felt cold. When he looked up, the three people were staring at him with eyes burning with fire. "When did you offend these three guys!?" Lin Zheng was depressed.
"Yuki!" Tifa happily hugged Yuki, "I miss you so much, sister! Let me see! Oh - it's still so cute! Yuki is the cutest!"
"Are you sure you don't regard Yuki as a cute toy?"
"Of course not!" Tifa sternly denied, "How can there be such a cute toy as Yuxi!" Yes, it is indeed a toy!
Sighing, Lin Zheng looked at Yuxi's delicate, emotionless face and asked, "Youxi, are you happy?"
Youxi looked at Lin Zheng with her clear eyes for several seconds, as if this question was difficult to answer. Everyone also calmed down and stared at Youxi. Yuxi, who had always been silent, how was her mood? Yuki may not understand what everyone expects, but she always answers questions seriously. Under the attention of several people, Yuki nodded gently, blinked her eyes and said, "Well! Happy!"
"That's right!" Hearing Youxi's answer, Lin Zheng smiled reassuringly, "That's good, as long as you are happy!"
"Yeah!" Xiaomeng and Tifa cheered, and the three grown men next to them also breathed a sigh of relief. They probably felt that it was a big sin to make such a fresh and refined girl unhappy!
After the happy meeting, it’s time to level up! But nowA problem has occurred! Captains below level 50 can only form a team of six people. Now the number is seven people, and when Xiao Meow comes up later, it will be eight people! As a result, we had to split up. Xiao Meng and Yu hope are definitely together, and so is Tifa. And according to Tifa's preferences, Xiao Miao will definitely be pulled away by her. Four boys and four girls, that seemed to be it, but in the end Xiaomeng pulled Lin Zheng away on the grounds that girls were not as powerful as boys. Under the glare of three pairs of fire-breathing eyes, Lin Zheng joined the girls team. There is no way, Lin Zheng is the one who reassures the girls the most.
At 2:10, Xiao Miao went online, and was pulled into the team by Tifa without any surprise. Without a doctor, the Overlords and the others were full of insecurities! But fortunately, after all, they are all leveling together. When the Overlord is short of blood, the little cat will run up to give him milk, so that the Overlord will not be beaten to death by a group of monsters!
Although there are no soldiers on the girls' team, there is no danger. The key is that the output is very powerful! After Tifa changed her weapon, her output was directly chasing Lin Zheng. With Lin Zheng and Xiao Meng, she could easily wipe out a small group of monsters without losing too much blood, not to mention that Xiao Meow was still adding blood. What Yuxi said was very unique. She was holding a book in one hand and looking at her with a wand in the other hand, throwing magic constantly. What made people speechless was that her magic never failed!
